name: Huge Sulfur Cube Expansion
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: Bojlier
description: Adds 24 unique Sulfur Cube Archetypes, the ability to control their sizes and an Advancement tree showing how to get all of them.

softOff.why: data pack files (recipes, loot, tags) stay

works: A data pack in a mod: 24 new sulfur cube archetypes (what a cube does by the item it swallowed: lights, explosions, healing, boombox...), cubes that grow or shrink with slime balls and others, and an advancement tree.
note: Not yet: Only the bigger archetype (a slime ball grows the cube) is checked. Its only mixins are the Fabric template's example ones, which do nothing.
